[[Winglord Caromi]] is a [[Tengu]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Black Curtain]]. This boss has a fixed spawn location and is a much higher level than the rest of the creatures in the area. It appears to be the leader of a group of [[Caromi Tengu Elite|Caromi Elite]].

*[[Feathered Caromi Scalp]]
*[[Tengu Armor]]

==Notes==
*This boss is one of six that the [[Krytan Herald]] at the [[Temple of the Ages]] warns about. All six bosses have levels that are much higher than the other foes in the area.
